slide 10 ('Worked Example: Forward Pass Implementation'): [code] Reshaping `K` and `V` using `L` (the query sequence length) causes a PyTorch runtime error if `key` and `value` have a different sequence length than `query`. Fix: Use `K = self.W_K(key).view(B, -1, self.num_heads, self.d_k).transpose(1, 2)` and `V = self.W_V(value).view(B, -1, self.num_heads, self.d_k).transpose(1, 2)` so the sequence dimension is dynamically inferred. C1.title: Dive into Deep Learning, chapter 11: Attention Mechanisms and Transformers

ai_review.verdict: The lecture deck is clear and well-aligned with learning outcomes, but the PyTorch forward pass implementation on Slide 10 needs to handle variable key/value sequence lengths safely before teaching.

issues.problem: Reshaping `K` and `V` using `L` (the query sequence length) causes a PyTorch runtime error if `key` and `value` have a different sequence length than `query`.
issues.fix: Use `K = self.W_K(key).view(B, -1, self.num_heads, self.d_k).transpose(1, 2)` and `V = self.W_V(value).view(B, -1, self.num_heads, self.d_k).transpose(1, 2)` so the sequence dimension is dynamically inferred.
